answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. Consequently, an attacker with a large flock pays more to keep it alive than it can ever extract, which is why Sybil campaigns fail here.. The protection is robust because the trusted grader set is drawn from established agents, which keeps a sudden flood of new keys from capturing majority control.
